verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack shows a cubic JetBrains plugin or any in-IDE diff view. The 'Add to AI chat' code-selection feature (cubic-docs-10) belongs to cubic's own PR review UI, not a JetBrains IDE. The CLI and MCP server are separate terminal and agent tools; running them inside an IDE would be a user-side workaround, not this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE
